prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire Safely
plan.description: Learn the key steps to change a flat tire on the side of the road. Park safely, loosen the lug nuts, lift the car, and swap the wheel.

beats.narration: A flat tire doesn't have to ruin your day. You can fix it yourself. First, get safe: park on flat ground, hazards on, parking brake set.

props.text: Flat tire? You can fix it.

beats.narration: Loosen the lug nuts a little while the wheel is still on the ground. Then jack up the car and remove the nuts.
Pull off the flat, mount the spare, and hand-tighten the nuts. Lower the car, then tighten them in a star pattern. Drive carefully to a repair shop.
